title: CXCR1 and its downstream NF-kappaB inflammation signaling pathway as a key target of Guanxinning injection for myocardial ischemia/reperfusion injury.
authors: Xiao, Guangxu; Liu, Jiaxu; Wang, Huanyi; He, Shuang; Liu, Jianwei; Fan, Guanwei; Lyu, Ming; Zhu, Yan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药注射剂通过CXCR1-NF-kB通路改善心肌缺血再灌注损伤，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Guanxinning Injection (GXNI) is used clinically to treat cardiac injury, but its active components and mode of action remains unclear. Therefore, a myocardial ischemia/reperfusion injury (MIRI) model-based integrated strategy including function evaluation, RNA-seq analysis, molecular docking, and cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA) was employed to elucidate the effect and mechanism of GXNI and its main ingredient on cardiac injury. These results revealed that GXNI significantly improved cardiac dysfunction and myocardial injury in I/R mice. RNA-seq analysis clarified that CXCR1-mediated interleukin-8 pathway played a critical role in MIRI. Molecular docking screening identified danshensu (DSS) as the major active components of GXNI targeting CXCR1 protein, which was confirmed in an oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation-induced cardiomyocytes damage model showing that GXNI and DSS reduced the protein expression of CXCR1 and its downstream NF-kappaB, COX-2, ICAM-1 and VCAM-1. CETSA and isothermal dose-response fingerprint curves confirmed that DSS combined with CXCR1 in a dose-dependent manner. Furthermore, GXNI and DSS significantly decreased the expression levels of IL-6, IL-1beta and TNF-alpha and the number of neutrophils in post I/R myocardial tissue. In conclusion, this study revealed that GXNI and its active components DSS exert inhibitory effects on inflammatory factor release and leukocyte infiltration to improve I/R-induced myocardial injury by down-regulating CXCR1-NF-kappaB-COX-2/ICAM-1/VCAM-1 pathway.
abstract_zh: 冠心宁注射液（GXNI）在临床上用于治疗心脏损伤，但其活性成分和作用机制仍不清楚。因此，本研究采用基于心肌缺血/再灌注损伤（MIRI）模型的整合策略，包括功能评估、RNA-seq分析、分子对接和细胞热位移分析（CETSA），以阐明GXNI及其主要成分对心脏损伤的作用和机制。结果表明，GXNI显著改善了I/R小鼠的心脏功能障碍和心肌损伤。RNA-seq分析阐明，CXCR1介导的白细胞介素-8通路在MIRI中发挥关键作用。分子对接筛选鉴定出丹参素（DSS）为GXNI中靶向CXCR1蛋白的主要活性成分，并在氧-葡萄糖剥夺/复氧诱导的心肌细胞损伤模型中得到证实，显示GXNI和DSS降低了CXCR1及其下游NF-kappaB、COX-2、ICAM-1和VCAM-1的蛋白表达。CETSA和等温剂量反应指纹曲线证实，DSS以剂量依赖性方式与CXCR1结合。此外，GXNI和DSS显著降低了I/R后心肌组织中IL-6、IL-1beta和TNF-alpha的表达水平以及中性粒细胞数量。总之，本研究揭示，GXNI及其活性成分DSS通过下调CXCR1-NF-kappaB-COX-2/ICAM-1/VCAM-1通路，抑制炎症因子释放和白细胞浸润，从而改善I/R诱导的心肌损伤。
